name: Chibi Chibi Con
organizer: Chibi Chibi Con Committee (The Evergreen State College RSO)
blurb: A free, student-run one-day anime and gaming convention at The Evergreen State College in Olympia, running since 2001.
notes: The site's own title tag and header still read 'Chibi Chibi Con – May 16th 2026 | The Evergreen State College in Olympia, WA | Since 2001' with no mention of 2027 anywhere on the homepage or About text, so no next edition has been announced yet; the May 16, 2026 one-day event (already past) is recorded as 'last'. No Guests page or guest program exists on the site (nav covers schedule, contests, artist alley and volunteering only); this is a small, free, student-run convention without a celebrity-guest model.
